description:
Advances: ueberauth_asgard.authorization_code

Ready-for: implement

Evidence:
Atlas dependency investigation at /Users/mz/Documents/my-vault/LLMs/investigations/atlas/2026-09-12-atlas-nkb/04-report.md confirms managed Asgard 0.4.0 uses HTTPoison.Base for token and certificate requests and explicitly starts HTTPoison. This retains vulnerable Hackney in Atlas. Current remote main ca49ce3a878b44064631a4274bad5ee0c7b8d4a0 includes accepted PKCE login; the older primary checkout has unrelated test_bypass.exs that must remain untouched.

Deliverable:
Replace the client HTTPoison transport with Req and remove HTTPoison from dependencies and extra_applications. Preserve actual current token/certificate contracts, JWKS parsing, Basic client authentication, form encoding, exact redirect URI, PKCE verifier, nonce validation, refresh, scopes, timeout bounds, sanitized errors and client Inspect redaction. Preserve explicit legacy implicit-token consumers. Disable implicit Req retry for code exchanges unless an existing equivalent policy is demonstrated; authorization codes are single-use. Use an isolated worktree at refreshed remote main. Root owns immutable Git-pin integration and release.

Verification:
Existing real Ueberauth authorization-code pipeline tests remain green. Add actual local HTTP transport witnesses for JWKS success/malformed/non-2xx, token exchange Basic auth and body fields, PKCE code verifier, refresh, connection failure and finite timeout. Verify remote errors and failed request inspection never expose secrets, tokens or verifier. Tests must exercise actual Req request and response handling rather than mock only the wrapper. Full suite, format and checked compile pass in a disposable local environment without credentials. Confirm dependency/runtime graph has no HTTPoison or Hackney. Atlas integration must pass full login/authorization tests, real release boot, zero-finding fresh audit and staging/production Playwright login plus logs. Existing Argos PKCE consumers must pass targeted compatibility tests before changing their pin. Iteration targeted tests; full suite final candidate; cold verifier targeted contract controls.

Allowed touches:
- mix.exs and mix.lock
- lib/ueberauth/strategy/asgard/client.ex
- Direct client and authorization-code tests and required local fixtures
- .spec/specs/ueberauth_asgard.authorization_code.spec.md and README transport description

Out of Scope (files):
Other strategy implementation, existing accepted decisions, unrelated test_bypass.exs, infrastructure, secret/env files and CI policy. Necessary path expansion requires a recorded root ruling before edits.

Out of Scope (intent):
No changed authentication semantics, new flows, authorization migration, production requests, secrets, merge, deployment, release publication, external dependency forks or advisory suppression. Root owns review and consumer release. No worker self-review or spawning.

Merge gate:
- Complete tests and required checks pass on exact candidate.
- Independent code review and cold verification approve.
- Root consumer graph resolves and actual application authentication remains verified.

Decision:
Use Req in owned client code while preserving the current strategy contract. A Hackney override is incompatible with the current HTTPoison API and constraints.

Open Questions:
None. Full Atlas graph and deployed consumer verification remain root integration gates.
